pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ viharati aggāḷave cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.2: tena kho pana samayena upāsakā ārāmaṃ āgacchanti dhammasavaṇāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.3: dhamme bhāsite therā bhikkhū yathāvihāraṃ gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.4: navakā bhikkhū tattheva upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ upāsakehi saddhiṃ muṭṭhassatī asampajānā naggā vikūjamānā kākacchamānā seyyaṃ kappenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.6: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhadantā muṭṭhassatī asampajānā naggā vikūjamānā kākacchamānā seyyaṃ kappessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ upāsakānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.9: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū anupasampannena sahaseyyaṃ kappessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.10: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū anupasampannena sahaseyyaṃ kappentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma te bhikkhave, moghapurisā anupasampannena sahaseyyaṃ kappessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.17.1: “yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.18: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena kosambī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena kosambi tadavasari. tatra sudaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati badarikārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.4: bhagavatā āvuso rāhula sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ na anupasampannena sahaseyyā kappetabbāti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.6: atha kho āyasmā rāhulo seyyaṃ alabhamāno vaccakuṭiyaṃ seyyaṃkappesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.7: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena vaccakuṭi tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ukkāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.12: atha kho āyasmā rāhulo bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.16.1: “yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttariṃ dirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.1.14: catutthe divase atthaṅgate sūriye, anupasampanne nipanne, bhikkhu nipajjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.1.15: bhikkhu nipanne anupasampanno nipajjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.2.1: anupasampanne anupasampannasaññī uttariṃ dirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.2.2: anupasampanne vematiko uttariṃ dirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.2.3: anupasampanne upasampannasaññī uttariṃ dirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
